bge_reranker.node_purpose: Score each VS1 pricing-and-mix candidate against every bounded RetrievalNeed so one generic need cannot suppress a partial but material disclosure.
bge_reranker.input_scale: One reviewed DELL request, ten bounded needs and at most ninety-six candidates.
required_outputs: one finite score per candidate-need pair
bge_reranker.schema_burden: pair-score matrix, stable candidate and need identities, cache digest and complete ordering
bge_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: a generic margin or AI term can outrank the actual reviewed pricing-and-mix disclosure when needs are collapsed
bge_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: VS1 v1.0 found both reviewed objects in the union but only one entered a generic reranker top ten
bge_reranker.reasoning_profile: local CUDA cross-encoder scoring without generation, network or training
bge_reranker.stop_and_truncation: 1024 tokens per pair, batch 2, finite matrix and fail closed on score or identity drift

qwen_reranker.node_purpose: Provide the same all-needs independent relevance signal for the exact VS1 business request.
qwen_reranker.input_scale: The same one-request candidate-need matrix as BGE.
required_outputs: one finite score per candidate-need pair
qwen_reranker.schema_burden: instruction-aware pair scores plus deterministic aggregation and cache receipt
qwen_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: semantic relevance alone may confuse segment result, product profit and unresolved bridge evidence
qwen_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: VS1 v1.0 Qwen surfaced one reviewed object while the role-guarded route suppressed it
qwen_reranker.reasoning_profile: local CUDA reranker shadow without generation, network or training
qwen_reranker.stop_and_truncation: 1024 tokens per pair, batch 2, finite matrix and fail closed on score or identity drift

why_replay_is_required: VS1 must consume the same final intent ontology, all-needs scoring and financial shortlist semantics as the main three-case and VS2 paths.
The previous VS1 replay only proved candidate-pool recall under the pre-ontology runtime.
Both reviewed DELL objects must remain reachable without target IDs or answer URLs in the query.
not_changed: compiled object population and reviewed VS1 target identities
hard identity, period, source and relationship filters
